g.text: Template Cache, Revision Artifact, and Session Lifecycles
adjust actual weight and own BundleLease
open load or activation BundleLease atomically
CAS if not current, no refs,
leases zero and final recheck passes
durable tombstone; cancel and drain run
drain and close; CAS DELETED; ref--
ACTIVE lease acquisition and eviction use one atomic protocol.
A Session TemplateLease pins an ACTIVE entry.
The entry owner releases its weight reservation exactly once.
A waiter timeout never cancels the shared load Future.
Cache load and publish activation leases pin an AVAILABLE artifact.
DELETING blocks new opens. GC rechecks current, persistent
Session references, leases, retention, and generation.
Run, mailbox work, and Store flush pin the Session.
Delete persists DELETING before irreversible cleanup.
Resume and delete share one lifecycle slot.
Concurrent cleanup callers join one owner Future.
